items.text: the **equalizer stays in full screen**. When the controls fade away, faint bars play under the grid, one per column, moving with the sound. Touch the screen and the controls come back (the bars go). The eye (clean) screen keeps its hold-to-exit bars rising to the line.

a setting, **Full screen exit bars**, in the heads-up display under Performance: **Equalizer** or **Plain bar**. Plain bar shows nothing while idle, and one straight bar that rises to the exit line when you hold.
Changed: the button next to the dice is now the **line-up button**. Its picture is the current line-up; tap it to choose another (it opens the same two-column menu; tap again to close it).

Changed: **holding the robot** now opens the heads-up display at its settings (tempo, how many lines, what happens when it stops). Tapping it still starts and stops it. The line-up menu moved to the new button.
Changed: **Swell** has a new picture, a crashing wave. It works as before: press and it swells, let go and it eases back.
Freeze is **in detention**: its pad is gone from the bar. The feature is kept: key F, and holding an empty cell in the hold hand, still freeze.

Removed: the **Ripple** and **Drain** line-ups, and "Ring widening" and "Ring closing" from the Way menus. Since the grid became rectangular they swept the same square rings as **Grow** and **Shrink**. Orbit, Breath and Whirl now use Grow and Shrink, and a saved look, piece or custom line-up that used the ring ways opens on Grow and Shrink.
icons for the **Shoreline** and **Two tides** line-ups. Breath's icon shows a square instead of a ring.

Fixed: in the line-ups menu (hold the play button) and the heads-up display, a line-up you had used a few times lost its name when Words is set to Learn, which left a blank yellow pill when it was chosen. Line-up names now always show.

Fixed: **Freeze could barely be heard.** It was a low, dark pad, and a phone speaker plays almost nothing under about 300 Hz. Measured, the part a phone could play was half as loud as an ordinary note. The drone now sits between C4 and B4 whatever the notes were, is brighter, louder, and comes in over about half a second instead of one and a half. The status line names the notes it holds.

Changed: **Freeze** now hears everything that sounded last: the grid's own sounds, recorded and sampled sounds (not drum banks, which have no pitch), and the field's sounds. Pressing Play no longer adds a stray note to what it remembers.

in the **hold hand**, press and hold an empty cell for about a third of a second and Freeze holds the last notes for as long as you keep pressing. A quick tap on an empty cell still does nothing. This works in full screen, with no pads.
Fixed: the Freeze pad's symbol vanished while it was on (yellow on yellow). It now shows dark on the yellow, like the other bar buttons.

a **Tuning** choice next to Scale and Root note (in the heads-up display and in the Field pane, kept in step). *Equal 12* is the ordinary tuning and changes nothing. *Just 12* tunes the twelve notes to clean whole-number ratios, so chords ring pure. *Equal 8* and *Just 8* use eight notes to the octave; each scale note moves to the nearest of them, so some fall between piano keys. It is kept with your look and with a saved piece. A scale that already sits between keys (Just) is left as it is.
**Freeze** (the fermata pad, key F). It takes the last few different notes you heard and holds them as a drone made of the field's sound. Tap to lock it on, tap again to let go; or hold and let go.
**Swell** (the hairpin pad, key S). While you hold it the sound and the room rise, and both ease back when you let go.
Changed: the small bar that floats beside whatever you tap in the G-code editor is now called the **G-code remote** (the Remote for short). Screen readers announce it by that name.
